# Button

Buttons for actions: primary (accent fill) for the one main action on a screen, secondary (card with outline) for the rest, ghost for back/toolbar actions.

`TVTracker.Button` · Actions

## Use

```jsx
<TVTracker.Button>…</TVTracker.Button>
```

```html
<x-import component-from-global-scope="TVTracker.Button">…</x-import>
```

| `children` | `React.ReactNode` |  |
| `variant` | `"primary" \| "secondary" \| "ghost"` |  |
| `icon` | `IconName` |  |

| `label` | `string` |  |
| `onClick` | `() => void` |  |
